# cJSON 1.7.19

Unmodified cJSON.c, cJSON.h and LICENSE from
https://github.com/DaveGamble/cJSON/tree/v1.7.19 (MIT).

SHA256:

- cJSON.c: 298581a04a36c0165da4b0aade235c23088cb2faa58651d720ea2f3706ed0b0d
- cJSON.h: 25b0145150d500498e4d209cec69c18c42cf818bffcc54690be3b895a2a16dee

Compiled with CJSON_NESTING_LIMIT=8 and CJSON_HIDE_SYMBOLS. The application
adds strict UTF-8/number/whitespace checks, flat-envelope validation,
duplicate-key rejection, and field/range validation around this parser.
